name: Stone of Relu
summary: In the Wetlands, the Stone of Relu is lost to a raptor after an ambush. Archaeologist Flagongut believes it can unlock secrets within ancient fossils.

sections.title: A Key to Ancient Relics
sections.body: Explorers' League work uncovered the Stone of Relu. Archaeologist Flagongut believes it can decipher prehistoric fossils gathered from Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. He means to use it on his Wetlands specimens and on the fossil Prospector Remtravel unearthed in Darkshore.

sections.title: Lost in the Marshes
sections.body: Archaeologist Flagongut was traveling along the Wetlands roads to meet Prospector Whelgar when mottled raptors ambushed him. In the scramble, the relic was lost and swallowed by one of the beasts. The League now seeks the marsh raptors so the ancient stone can be cut from their gullets.

faq.q: What is the Stone of Relu?
faq.answer: The Stone of Relu is an ancient artifact sought by Archaeologist Flagongut. He believes it can unlock the hidden mysteries and power within prehistoric fossils.

faq.q: How did the stone end up inside a raptor?
faq.answer: Archaeologist Flagongut carried the relic along a Wetlands road to meet Prospector Whelgar when mottled raptors attacked. In the chaos, one of the beasts swallowed the lost stone.

faq.q: What is Flagongut planning to do with the stone?
faq.answer: Flagongut plans to use the stone with his recovered fossil and the fossil Prospector Remtravel found in Darkshore, to decipher and release their latent magical secrets.

angles.text: For the Explorers' League, the Stone of Relu helps piece together the origins of ancient life and the world's forgotten legacy.
Alliance expeditions in Menethil Harbor rely on recovered artifacts like the Stone of Relu to justify difficult excavations across the perilous marshlands.
